-- 击飞
function kickAss(character:Model)
	if not GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) then return end
	local humanoid:Humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	local Torso:Part = character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	local offset = (character:GetPivot().Position - model:GetPivot().Position)
	local dir = (offset * CommonEnum.XZ).Unit

	local velocity = dir * 30 + Vector3.new(0,10,0)
	local a = 30

	humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown)
	local owner = Torso:GetNetworkOwner()
	Torso:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	Torso.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity
	Torso.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(a,math.random(-a,a),math.random(-a,a))
	task.wait(0.1)
	Torso:SetNetworkOwner(owner)
end

-- 刷新目标
function updateTarget()
	-- 1.目标是否存活
	-- 2.目标是否在战场
	if GameHelper:isAlive(v_targetPlayer.Value) and v_targetPlayer.Value.Character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnWildBoarBattleGround) then
		return
	end
	
	v_targetPlayer.Value = nil
	if not v_targetPlayer.Value then
		local characters = game.CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.OnWildBoarBattleGround)
		while #characters > 0 do
			local character = table.remove(characters,math.random(1,#characters))
			if GameHelper:CharacterIsAlive(character) then
				v_targetPlayer.Value = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
				break
			end
		end	
	end
end

-- 砸地攻击
function skill_PoundGround()
	v_Busy.Value = true
	--poundGround:Play()
	humanoidRootPart.PoundGround:Play()
	task.delay(1.5,function()
		poundGroundTrack:Play()
	end)

	-- 砸地时长
	local t = 4
	local range = v_Mad.Value and 40 or 30
	model.Order:FireAllClients("砸地",range,t)
	task.wait(t)
	humanoidRootPart.Bomb:Play()
	model.LocalOrder:Fire("砸地")
	
	-- 起来要2秒
	task.wait(2)
	--moveCD = 1
	updateTarget()
	v_Busy.Value = false
end

function normalAttack()
	v_Busy.Value = true
	attackTrack:Play()
	
	humanoidRootPart.Preattack:Play()
	local t = 1.5
	local range = v_Mad.Value and 38 or 30
	model.Order:FireAllClients("普攻",range,t)
	task.wait(3)
	v_Busy.Value = false
end

function triggerAttack()
	local pattern = _attackPatterns[_attackIndex]
	_attackIndex += 1
	if _attackIndex > #_attackPatterns then
		_attackIndex = 1
	end
	--print("triggerAttack",pattern)
	if pattern == 1 then
		normalAttack()
	elseif pattern == 2 then
		skill_PoundGround()
	end

end

function onSleepingChanged()
	if v_Sleeping.Value then
		--humanoidRootPart.Anchored = true
		v_Busy.Value = true
		humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero)
		if idleTrack.IsPlaying then idleTrack:Stop() end
		if not sleepTrack.IsPlaying then sleepTrack:Play() end
		humanoidRootPart.Sleep:Play()
	else
		--humanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
		v_Busy.Value = true
		getupTrack:Play()
		humanoidRootPart.Sleep:Stop()
		task.delay(1,function()
			-- 考虑到首次播放需要加载不及时，演示停止这些需要停止的动画
			if idleTrack.IsPlaying then idleTrack:Stop() end
			if sleepTrack.IsPlaying then sleepTrack:Stop() end
		end)
		task.wait(3)
		
		idleTrack:Play()
		v_Busy.Value = false
	end	
end

model.Order.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, cmd:string,skillName:string) 
	if cmd ~= "攻击命中" then return end
	
	if skillName == "砸地" then
		local damage = 30
		if v_Mad.Value then
			damage *= 2
		end
		damage *= EnemyHelper:GetGameEnemyDamageRateValue().Value
		GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(player,damage,model)
		if GameHelper:isAlive(player) then
			kickAss(player.Character)
		end
	elseif skillName == "普攻" then
		local damage = 20
		if v_Mad.Value then
			damage *= 2
		end
		damage *= EnemyHelper:GetGameEnemyDamageRateValue().Value
		GameHelper:PlayerTakeDamage(player,damage,model)
	end
end)

	end

local isTrigger = false
local originCastleCFrame = Castle:GetPivot()

math.randomseed(tick())
function onIsDaytimeChanged()
	if v_isDaytime.Value then
		Castle.Parent = nil
	else
		Castle.Parent = script.Parent
		Castle.Core:FindFirstChild("出现"):Play()
		-- 从下方移动上来
		task.spawn(function()
			local startCFrame = originCastleCFrame - Vector3.new(0,100,0)
			Castle:PivotTo(startCFrame)
			
			local t = 0
			local totalT = 1
			while Castle.Parent do
				local dt = task.wait()
				t += dt
				local alpha = math.min(t / totalT,1)
				Castle:PivotTo(startCFrame:Lerp(originCastleCFrame,alpha))
				if alpha == 1 then break end
			end
		end)
	end
end

function triggerEvent()
	if isTrigger then return end
	isTrigger = true

	if v_isDaytime.Value then
		-- 立即天黑
		v_dayCD.Value = 1
	else
		-- 重置夜晚的时长
		v_dayCD.Value = workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("夜晚时长").Value
		--ValueHelper:SetValue(gameController,TimeValue.cd,workspace.GameValue:FindFirstChild("夜晚时长").Value)
	end

	task.wait(2)

	Castle.Core:FindFirstChild("scary laughing"):Play()

	local enemyParent = Instance.new("Folder")
	enemyParent.Name = "幽灵城堡敌人"
	enemyParent.Parent = script

	-- 生成敌人
	for _,child in ipairs(script:FindFirstChild("生成敌人位置"):GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Attachment") then
			local enemyId = tonumber(child.Name)

			local enemy:Model = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId,enemyParent)
			if enemy then
				enemy:PivotTo(child.WorldCFrame)
			end
		end
	end
end

local v_maxValue = root.MaxValue

local _convertValue = 0
root.TouchPart.Touched:Connect(function(otherPart: BasePart)  
	local item:Model = CommonFunc:FindFirstAncestorByTag(otherPart,GameEnum.Tag.ResourcesItem)
	if not item then return end -- 非资源道具
	if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Iron) then -- 只能是铁
		local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(item)
		-- 添加材料
		local addValue = tonumber(resItemLo.param) or 1
		_convertValue += addValue
		ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item)
		root.TouchPart.Add:Play()
		
		while addValue > 0 do
			task.wait(0.1)
			local v = 1
			addValue -= v
			v_curValue.Value += v
		end
	end
end)

	if v_curValue.Value >= v_maxValue.Value then
		v_curValue.Value -= v_maxValue.Value
		-- 生成子弹
		ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(504,root.Spawn.WorldCFrame)
	end
end)
